subject: Computer Science
title: Class 10 Computer Science Olympiad — Paper 5
instructions: The time allowed for this paper is 60 minutes.
This paper contains 50 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions carrying a total of 60 marks.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
Each question has four options; choose the one correct answer.
Section 1 and other regular sections carry 1 mark per question; the Achievers Section carries 3 marks per question.
Use of calculators is not permitted unless specified.

questions.question: A file is 240 KB. Approximately how many such files fit in 1 MB (1 MB = 1024 KB)?
If A=1, B=2, C=3, and so on, what does the code '3-15-13-16-21-20-5-18' spell?
Find the next term: 2, 4, 8, 16, __
Which of these is not like the others: RAM, ROM, CPU, USB drive
options: USB drive (external storage, others are internal components)

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Python, Java, HTML, C++
options: HTML (markup language, others are programming languages)

questions.question: If FILE is coded as EHKD, how is DATA coded?

options: Monitor (output device, others are networking devices)

questions.question: In a Python program, a loop is meant to run 5 times using 'for i in range(5):' but the student wants it to print numbers 1 to 5 instead of 0 to 4. What change is needed?
options: No change needed, 0 to 4 is correct for 1 to 5

questions.question: A student wants to design a webpage where clicking a button changes the background colour. Which combination of technologies is needed?
